Last year I was selected to represent our state at the national debate championship. The letter came during maths class. Our teacher read it out and everyone turned to look at me.
My face went hot. I said, "They must have run out of people," and everyone laughed. At lunch, my friend Anirban said, "That's huge!" and I said, "It's just talking. Anyone can do it."

Vinita, I tell myself now, you were allowed to be happy out loud.
